checkFailed: Could not check for recovery drafts. Try again when connected.
title: Recoverable record drafts
description: Unsaved checkpoints in this workspace. A draft may still be open in another window. Review it before saving it as a record.
live: The list updates as checkpoints change. Refresh to see the newest drafts.
loadFailed: Recovery drafts could not be loaded. Retry this page or refresh the list.
invalidPage: The recovery draft response was incomplete. Refresh the list to try again.
recoveredCopy: Draft recovered. Another copy remains in the draft list because it changed or could not be removed.
checkpointed: Record draft checkpointed {time}. Record not saved.
notCheckpointed: Draft not checkpointed. Keep this window open and retry.
notCheckpointedReason: Draft not checkpointed: {reason} Your edits remain in this window.
removeFailed: Record saved or discarded, but its recovery checkpoint could not be removed. Review saved drafts before recovering older work.
paused: Automatic record checkpoints pause while other workspace changes are unsaved.
workspaceChanged: This draft belongs to a different workspace.
recovered: Draft recovered into the editor. Review it before saving.
previewDescription: Inspect the checkpoint's summary and sections before recovering it. Recovery also retains its other fields, figures and relationships.
recordsDescription: Recover one record at a time. The others stay here.
